notes: When an antivirus blocks or quarantines Winput LAN, the module page says so and explains how to restore it, instead of only stopping.
Winput LAN starts again on its own once the file is restored from quarantine, with no SwissTechKnife restart.
If an antivirus removes only one of the two copies of the app, the module starts the remaining one.
Disabling the module or closing SwissTechKnife while Winput LAN was exiting no longer raises an internal error.
Double-clicking the module's notification-area icon opens the Winput LAN window.
First release as a SwissTechKnife module: starts with SwissTechKnife in its own process, without a notification-area icon.
Settings, known machines and this PC's identity are copied from the regular installation on first run.
Allowing control of administrator apps asks for Windows confirmation once; afterwards the module starts with that permission.
The regular Winput LAN and the module never run at the same time.
